call_input.prompt:
Use case: ads-marketing.
Create exactly one finished flat landscape 3:2 launch poster for the fictional ARVO Fold Stand. One poster only, no panels, no contact sheet, no room mockup. 요청한 화면 비율을 유지하면서 현재 도구와 모델이 지원하는 가능한 최대 해상도로 출력.

Visual idea: the same articulated silver aluminum reading stand in two photographed states, with its opened triangular load-bearing structure and its compact folded thickness forming the poster's main visual relationship. This should read immediately as a working reading stand launch, with its function clear before small details. Use restrained photographic product advertising with carefully designed typography, rather than an engineering diagram.

Create a single coherent studio composition on a pale cool-gray tabletop seamlessly meeting a pale cool-gray backdrop. A large opened stand sits center-right, shown from a low front-right three-quarter angle so the front retaining lip, right-side hinge, rear angle-adjustment support brace, and brace seating on the grounded base are all visible at the same time. An open, entirely unlettered neutral book rests against the inclined backplate; its lower page/block edge visibly contacts and is supported by the front lip. The book is real-photograph-like with matte off-white paper, subtle page curvature, and a blank gray cloth cover. No lettering whatsoever on any book page, cover or spine.

Stand architecture: a clean rectangular brushed silver aluminum backplate with softly rounded corners; a slim hinged retaining lip across its lower front edge; a base plate resting firmly on the tabletop; two coherent pivot joints connecting the main plate to the base along the lower edge; a rear metal U-shaped support brace pivoted to the backplate and seated in one of several unnumbered recessed detents on the base. The support forms a clearly legible stable triangle viewed from the right. Show a plausible five-stage detent mechanism without printed labels, exaggerated engineering detail or any added technical claim. Every member should connect visibly rather than floating or stopping before its joint. The book's weight travels through the inclined plate and front lip into the grounded base and seated brace. Preserve space around the right-side structure so it is not obscured.

A folded instance of exactly the same hypothetical stand lies horizontally in the lower-left foreground and extends toward the opened stand. Show its thin closed side profile at a shallow three-quarter angle: the matching rounded rectangular backplate folded down onto its base, front lip folded flat, rear brace nested beneath, and the same small hinge geometry at the edge. Both photographed instances share identical material, shape language, hardware and light direction. They are two states of one model, not unrelated products. Keep both complete and readable, with contact shadows on the same surface. No other props or decorative marks.

Typography and composition: build an asymmetrical, integrated poster with a dark graphite typographic column in the upper-left and middle-left, and the large opened product at center-right. The opened supporting triangle is visually answered by a sturdy bold Korean phrase, while the thin folded foreground edge is answered by the second phrase in a slightly lighter weight and a wide, calm horizontal line. Use a precise contemporary sans-serif with clear Korean strokes, ordinary word spaces, balanced letter spacing and high contrast. The title and phrase should be substantial enough to read at screen-use size. ARVO is ordinary typographic display copy, not a symbol, emblem, monogram or actual logo. Place ARVO near the upper-left, with Fold Stand beneath as a strong two-word title. The Korean sentence can wrap at the comma into two meaning-related lines without changing its wording or word spaces. Keep the complete six supplied items exactly once. The specification, release date and URL should occupy a deliberately generous, readable lower band, without overlapping the folded product or its silhouette. Use no boxes, icons, arrows, dimension lines, additional labels or numbering. Set the supplied specification in an easy-to-read medium size, and group release line and URL together with clear spacing. The reading path should move from identity and product name through the paired functional sentence and photographed support/fold, then to specification and launch information. Preserve generous but purposeful margins.

Photographic finish: convincing silver anodized/brushed aluminum, fine restrained directional brushing, realistic soft specular edges and slightly darker hardware recesses. Soft directional studio light from upper left creates consistent gentle shadows and reveals the surfaces and joints. Matte paper and cloth must remain visually different from metal. Deep enough focus for book contact, front lip, hinge, brace seating and folded edges to remain visible. No exaggerated chrome, plastic-looking metal, bloom, halos or surreal floating objects.

The only printed words in the artwork are these six exact supplied items, once each, with original spelling, punctuation and word spaces:
ARVO
Fold Stand

알루미늄 접이식 독서대 · 각도 5단계
